common.primary_statistics: mean and Student-t 95% CI across paired seeds; per-seed paired differences
common.cdf_statistics: pooled raw workflow observations plus seed-stratified bootstrap sensitivity
common.identity_gates: workflow, probe, failure-domain, model/config, source, and raw hashes
common.evidence_boundary: metadata DES unless separately matched to physical data

hardware_topology.same_node_peer_rule: another GPU on the source node
hardware_topology.cross_node_peer_rule: same local GPU index on (source_node + 1) mod node_count
hardware_topology.remote_dram_rule: CPU DRAM attached to (source_node + 1) mod node_count
hardware_topology.path_bandwidth_rule: same-node and cross-node Peer-HBM, and local and remote DRAM, retain separate copy and recovery bandwidth fields; cross-node paths must never inherit same-node values

modeled_bandwidth_profile.required_sensitivity: S7 must vary the directional values without altering S1/S2 lineage; no A100 measurement claim is permitted.

fault_domains.source_node: all eight global GPU ranks on floor(source_rank / 8)

excluded_from_primary_comparison.RAIDServe: In the current TP1 component model it is implementation-equivalent to modeled Native Mooncake; it may appear only in a supplemental equivalence table, not as independent evidence.
excluded_from_primary_comparison.Recompute Only: It is a recovery mechanism, not an architecture baseline, and must not be used to inflate the architecture count.

S1.question: architecture WCT CDF at the central registered workload

execution_topology.placement: one TP1/PP1 replica per GPU; contiguous ranks 0-7 on node 0 and 8-15 on node 1

S1.matrix: 6 architectures x 2 failure domains x 3 seeds
S1.statistics: healthy and same-probe all-workflow CDF; p50/p95/p99 with seed bootstrap CI

S2.question: concurrency curves at three failure rates

execution_topology.placement: identical to S1; rate cells share paired workflow/fault-probe universes before rate aggregation

S2.matrix: 2 policies x 5 concurrency levels x 3 rates x 3 seeds
S2.statistics: paired mean WCT and 95% CI; rate-specific executed Poisson failure traces, not a heatmap or changed-only subset

S3.question: GPU scale and context sensitivity for two explicitly configured models

topology_by_system_dp.placement: one TP1/PP1 replica per GPU, contiguous global ranks per 8-GPU node

service_and_recompute.boundary: registered synthetic DES coefficients; not an A100 physical profile

topology_by_system_dp.placement: each TP1/PP4 pipeline occupies four contiguous GPUs within one 8-GPU node; two complete pipeline replicas per node
topology_by_system_dp.fault_scope: source_worker_gpu loses one PP stage GPU; source_node loses all eight GPUs and therefore two complete PP4 pipeline replicas

models.weight_partition_note: four contiguous 16-layer PP stages with embedding/head tensors assigned to their boundary stages; stage totals sum exactly to the official safetensors total

service_and_recompute.required_service_formula: prefill_setup_ms + context_tokens * prefill_ms_per_token + output_tokens * decode_ms_per_token + registered PP bubble/serialization
service_and_recompute.required_recompute_formula: prefill_setup_ms + recomputed_tokens * prefill_ms_per_token with the same matched profile
service_and_recompute.execution_gate: Do not execute or publish the Qwen3-32B S3 cells until the matched A100 40GB TP1/PP4 service and recompute profile is frozen and hashed.

S3.matrix: (Qwen3-8B TP1/PP1: 2 policies x 5 DP scales x 5 contexts x 3 seeds) + (Qwen3-32B TP1/PP4: same dimensions after its profile gate passes)
S3.statistics: healthy and same-probe WCT mean/CI, throughput, queue and capacity mechanisms; model/layout reported separately

S4.question: Algorithms 1/2/3 ablation under a preregistered mechanism-active cell
S4.matrix: 5 policies x 2 failure domains x 3 seeds
S4.statistics: normalized all-workflow total WCT with paired 95% CI plus coverage counters; changed-only diagnostic excluded from ranking

S5.question: alpha, pressure/load, and HBM/DRAM occupancy timelines
S5.matrix: AegisKV x 5 load levels x 3 seeds
S5.statistics: per-control-window mean/range and capacity integrals; inclusive and fixed steady cohort
S5.required_raw: event-level used_bytes, active serving, queue integral, alpha and release/dispatch counts

S6.question: real shared-prefix reuse effect
S6.matrix: 2 policies x 4 reuse fractions x 3 seeds
S6.statistics: reuse hit, copy amplification, evictions, recovery hit and time-integrated GiB with CI
S6.gate: reuse must be shared-prefix identity, not merely shortened context

S7.question: four transfer paths and repair sensitivity
S7.matrix: bandwidth: 2 policies x 4 paths x 5 bandwidths x 3 seeds; repair: 2 policies x 2 domains x 4 durations x 3 seeds
S7.statistics: all-workflow total WCT and recovery-service CI; separate copy and load directions

S8.question: source worker/GPU versus source-node failure
S8.statistics: same-probe all-workflow WCT and added-WCT CI; exact 1-rank versus 8-rank domain audit

S9.question: simulation versus matched physical calibration for all four transfer directions
S9.statistics: matched throughput, ratio and absolute percentage error by join key (path,payload_mib)
S9.boundary: physical RTX4090 and matched simulator profile; never labeled A100 measurement

minimum_unique_cells_note: S1 and S8 share the same 36 central architecture cells. No S4 reuse is deducted; any later reuse requires exact protocol and identity-gate equality.
